description: The Follow-ETSAP team publishes regional industrial energy-demand estimates for a 2018 reference year. The current Zenodo version 2.1.0 package separates production quantities from energy calculations and includes a file mapping territories to TIAM regions. It is available free under CC BY 4.0. These sector and process estimates can provide industrial-load inputs for energy-system planning, with model-pypsa-eur a related but differently regionalized model. A caveat is that production statistics and energy-intensity assumptions do not measure every plant or operational shift. The TIAM region definitions and process boundaries must be kept attached when converting the numbers to other geographic or technology categories. The own release metadata and file manifest were inspected without opening calculated tables. The manuscript's DOI points to the concept, not the latest version, so version labels must accompany later comparisons.
